text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Phew... Good morning!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Scarlet! Get a load of this! Did you hear
about
Vodka?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: No... What's she done now?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Well, the thing is...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
What the heck! You're leaving the
dorm?! What's
going on?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: That's right! I'm headin' overseas.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: What?! Overseas?! Now?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Yep! Call it a warrior's pilgrimage.
Sounds pretty
cool, right?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Time out! Trainer, keep me sane here!
Tell me
she's being ridiculous!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I mean... overseas?! And she didn't even discuss it with me first! I'm supposed to be her roommate!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Don't you tell me to calm down! Idiot!
Dummy!
Jerk of all jerks!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Sigh...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Daiwa Scarlet collapses onto the sofa.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Knock, knock! Coming in!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Scarlet! Can you help Vodka move
out?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
It's super sudden, so Prez is desperate
for a pair
of hands...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: No way.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, don't be like that! We really
need all the
help we can get!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
What?! Absolutely not! That's my room
too!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Sounds good to me! ♪ Let's go give Prez
a hand!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hey! Aren't you even going to ask my

permission?! Hey! Wait!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Phew! Looks like that's the worst of it!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Nice job. I've got some paperwork to do,
so I'll let
you finish up.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Boo! But I guess that's Vodka for you...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Well, whatever! More work just means
more
praise from Prez!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Whatever floats your boat. Anyway, see
ya later,
Scarlet.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: She's really gone.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Of course not.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
It's just... now the room looks the same
as before
she came.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
On my first day at the academy, I came
straight
here after I finished my
paperwork.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
And the whole time I was unpacking all
my things,
I was wondering what kind of
roommate I was
going to get.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I mean, if it turned out to be an
upperclassman,
I'd be super nervous,
you know?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
And then she showed up... Can you
guess the first
thing she did?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
She said, "'Sup," before putting up all of
her
motorcycle posters!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
She could have at least tried to make

conversation! We were going to be
roommates!
It's only good manners!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Now that I think about it, she's always
done
whatever she felt like.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Entering the Derby, gallivanting off
overseas...
She's always so
unpredictable.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: So why...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Why am I always so sure that she'll come
out on
top?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Why do I always look forward to seeing
her next
step?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
And why can I so easily picture her
becoming
number one?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
It's not just me who thinks this way—it's
everyone.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Didn't you see? Back at the Queen
Elizabeth II
Cup, she was all anyone
could talk about!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: She can really be.... so unfair.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I want to be number one.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
When people think of the best
Umamusume, I
want them to picture me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daiwa Scarlet's feelings towards being
"number
one" rush out like a raging river.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For as long as I've known her, she's
always wanted
to be number one...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But today, I feel like I've gotten a
glimpse of what
that really means.
